source: 環境省生物多様性センター 巨樹・巨木林データベース (Biodiversity Center of Japan, giant tree database)
endpoint: POST https://kyoju.biodic.go.jp/?_action=gtsearch with place_filter=1 and prefecture_code, then one detail fetch per record; see scripts/jp_kyoju.py --detail
licence: 公共データ利用規約 1.0 (PDL 1.0), commercial reuse with attribution
licence_proof: biodic.go.jp/copyright/terms_of_service.html, read 2026-08-04. The same page reserves user submissions to their posters, which is why only ユーザ=Admin rows (the ministry's own 1988/2000 survey) are kept here.
attribution: 環境省生物多様性センター 巨樹・巨木林データベース, extract of 2026-09-08
scope: 1648 prefecture rows read, 146 in 奈良市, 136 kept as ministry survey records
caveat: NO COORDINATES. Prefecture, municipality, town and a facility name, never a lat/lon, so every pin is a separate job. Girth and height are the survey figures at 確認年月日, often 2000, so add the years since. owner_ja answers hard rule 10 from the data: 社寺 is shrine or temple ground and publishable under the churches clause, 個人 is private and stays out. facility_ja is the only locating string this register gives and it is empty on 73 of 136.
found: Detail-page fields added 2026-09-08: 123 of 136 carry an age band and 134 a height, neither of which the result list shows. 67 of Nara city's ministry records are 300年以上.
